# Steam Vault v1.3.0

**Release date:** 2026-10-15
**Version Type:** Semantic Versioning

## ✨ Highlights

Steam Vault v1.3.0 introduces a major transformation with a brand-new **Executive Gaming Dashboard**, dedicated **Multi-Platform Storage Analytics & Installed Games Explorer**, native **Per-Game Installation Directory Management with Cross-Drive Relocation**, and a high-performance **Redis-Compatible In-Memory KV Tier**. 

This release streamlines the entire gaming management experience: users gain instant visual access to real-time library KPIs, recent titles with instantaneous launch actions, and cross-platform storefront capacity distribution, all while retaining fine-grained control over multi-drive storage footprints and clean, zero-residue Windows uninstall hooks.

---

## 🚀 Key Improvements & Features

- **Executive Gaming Dashboard (`/`)** — Replaces legacy metadata provider lists with an executive control center:
  - **KPI Metrics Strip**: At-a-glance visibility into Total Library games, Ready-to-Play titles, aggregate Total Playtime, Starred Favorites, and Free Connected Storage capacity.
  - **"Jump Back In" Hero & Carousel**: Dynamic carousel of recently played and favorite games with direct one-click `▶` launch buttons, recent session indicators, and live playtime stats.
  - **Storefront Ecosystem Capacity Distribution**: Proportional multi-platform progress bar charting installed footprint distributions across Steam, GOG, Epic Games, Xbox, EA, Ubisoft, Battle.net, and emulators.
  - **Top Played Titles Leaderboard**: Quick-ranking leaderboard showcasing the user's most-played titles and invested hours.
  - **Quick Actions Hub**: One-click navigation to Library, Storage Explorer, Manual Shortcut Addition, and Platform Settings.

- **Multi-Platform Storage Analytics & Storage Explorer (`/storage`)** — Replaces manual folder registration with an automated multi-store storage intelligence center:
  - **Multi-Platform Usage Breakdown**: Capacity meters and game counts across all 12 supported platforms with brand-specific visual accents.
  - **Connected Storage Drives Overview**: Visual volume utilization bars highlighting aggregate used space, available free space, and the dedicated gaming footprint on each mounted drive.
  - **Installed Games Storage Explorer**: Searchable, platform-filterable directory explorer with proportional size progress bars and direct deep links (`/library?game=<appId>`) to game details.

- **Per-Game Installation Directory Management & Cross-Drive Relocation (`/library`)**:
  - **Installation & Storage Card**: Per-game details sub-page reveals exact disk size, resolved root installation path (accounting for relative Steam manifests and absolute non-Steam paths), executable path, and a one-click "📂 Open Folder" action.
  - **Atomic Cross-Drive Move Tool**: Built into the game Manage modal, allowing users to move installed Steam games between registered library folders. Includes pre-flight free space safety verification (`preview_move_game`) and atomic directory relocation with automated `appmanifest_<appid>.acf` rewriting (`move_game`).

- **Serverless In-Memory & Backend Redis-Compatible KV Tier (`cache.rs`, `redis.ts`)**:
  - High-performance Redis-compatible key-value storage engine handling ultra-fast transient caching of game stats, metadata lookups, and session state.
  - Fully exposed via strongly typed Tauri IPC commands (`redis_get`, `redis_set`, `redis_del`, `redis_keys`, `redis_flush`).

- **Epic Games Launcher & Legendary CLI Integration (`launchers.rs`)**:
  - Added configurable binary and folder path support (`legendary_path`) allowing users to designate custom standalone installations outside PATH (e.g. `E:\Games\Epic Games\Legendary`).
  - Multi-platform auto-detection scanning installation directories, user tools folders, and mounted drives.
  - Added a dedicated "Download Legendary ↗" action pointing directly to GitHub Releases alongside the 1-click built-in downloader.
  - Enables direct, lightweight launching of Epic Games titles even when the official Epic Games Launcher is not running or not installed.

- **Clean Uninstallation NSIS Hooks (`hooks.nsh`)**:
  - Embedded Windows NSIS uninstaller lifecycle hooks ensuring complete post-uninstall sanitization of WebView2 runtime caches, local app data, and temporary files.

---

## ✅ Changed

- **Sidebar & Status Cleanliness**: Removed persistent "Steam is closed / running" process notice from the global sidebar. Live process monitoring has been relocated exclusively inside the Advanced Mode operation card in `/settings`.
- **Database Schema Upgrade**: Upgraded offline SQLite cache to schema v4 with dedicated user review score caching.
- **Library Folder Management**: Removed redundant manual Steam library folder deletion/addition controls from the Storage view in favor of automated launcher autodetection and per-game relocation workflows.

---

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Epic Games Account Portal OAuth `client_not_found` Error**: Resolved `{"errorCode":"errors.com.epicgames.accountportal.client_not_found"}` by replacing outdated/deprecated client tokens with the active Legendary portal helper (`https://legendary.gl/epiclogin`) and valid client ID (`34a02cf8f4414e29b15921876da36f9a`), alongside resilient credential parsing for authorization codes, JSON payloads, and session ID (`--sid`) cookies.
- **Chromium WebView2 Win32 Window Class Unregistration**: Resolved `UnregisterClassW failed: 1412 (ERROR_CLASS_ALREADY_EXISTS)` during rapid window teardown and reload in debug mode.
- **Relative Path Resolution for Installed Games**: Fixed Steam manifest `installDir` relative path stems to properly resolve against each library folder's parent `steamapps/common/` path.
- **Provider Image Fallback Cascades**: Fixed catalogue indexer to cleanly cascade header, capsule, hero, logo, and icon images across all secondary metadata providers when primary store images are absent.

## 🛠️ Build, Installation & Verification

Steam Vault is built with Tauri v2, Rust 1.77+, SvelteKit, and Vite.

### Local Build Commands

```bash
# Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/HELIX-Origin/Steam-Vault.git
cd Steam-Vault

# Install frontend dependencies
npm install

# Run automated test & verification suite
node scripts/test.mjs frontend i18n

# Build local production release (unsigned)
npm run tauri:build:release
```

### Verification Results

All automated verification test suites passed cleanly prior to release:
- **Rust Type-Check (`cargo check`)**: `PASS` (0 errors)
- **Rust Unit & Integration Tests (`cargo test`)**: `PASS` (43/43 tests passing)
- **Frontend Svelte Type-Check (`svelte-check`)**: `PASS` (0 errors, 0 warnings across all routes and components)
- **i18n Multi-Language Engine (`verify-i18n.mjs`)**: `PASS` (30/30 official Steam platform languages validated)
